newsitem.title: USA: Baxter to buy Bieffe units for $185 mln.
newsitem.headline: Baxter to buy Bieffe units for $185 mln.

text.p: Baxter International inc and Clark SRL said on Monday they have entered into an agreement for Baxter to acquire the dialysis, intravenous therapy and irrigation solutions businesses of Bieffe Medital SpA.
The acquisition price, said Baxter, is $185 million plus assumption of $50 million in debt.

The agreement is subject to satisfactory due diligence review to be completed within 60 days, approval of antitrust authorities in Europe and other customary closing conditions, said Baxter. The sale is expected to close before the end of the year.
Beiffe is a Swiss-based company with 1996 revenues of about $100 million. Baxter's 1996 sales were $5.4 billion.
